name: Jim Curtis
reason: Re-checked under the new rule (12 Nov 2026): his own site (www.jimcurtiscoaching.com home page, read 12 Nov 2026) is built on his Hypno-Coaching approach (hypnotherapy, NLP and subconscious reprogramming) delivered as private coaching, coaching courses on heartbreak, rebuilding and manifestation, an app and a membership whose entry offer is a 'Hypno-Realization' session; he leads no meditation, yoga, retreat or contemplative practice as such. Under the scope test that is therapy and coaching, not spiritual practice, and one of the site's main focus areas ('Chronic illness & physical pain', healing the roots of illness so the body can recover) is a treatment claim the health rule leaves out. His photos are on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses us.
